snippet.title: Hype : The Time Quest - video game 'early' trailer (1998)
snippet.description:
Hype : The Time Quest   , official trailer.
Developed by Ubi Soft Divertissements (Canada)
Published in 1999  by Ubi Soft  for PC (Windows). and in 2001 for Playstation 2.
Game Boy Color conversion ported by Planet Interactive Development and published by Ubi Soft in 2001.

Year : 1998 (trailer), 1999 (PC version), 2001 (Playstation 2 and Game Boy Color)
System : PC (Windows) , Playstation 2, Game Boy Color.

 One of the 3 Ubi Soft games  using the Playmobil toys design and licence (The others are 'Alex Build his Farm' and Laura's Happy Adventures'). This one is an an Action-Adventure game

Trailer  found on the 'Ubi Soft Multimedia Catalog' disc (fall 1998).
